challenge.method: Traced GetValue against IsPropertyReference, IsSuperReference and IsPrivateReference in §§6.2.5.1 and 6.2.5.3–4, then checked the two fields at creation in §13.3.7.3 MakeSuperPropertyReference.
challenge.results: MakeSuperPropertyReference fills [[Base]] from GetSuperBase and [[ThisValue]] from actualThis. With distinct values, the first determines the dispatch object after ToObject and the second remains the receiver. An ordinary property reference obtains its receiver from [[Base]], and the private path exits through PrivateGet.

limitations: Successful ToObject is required. The actual [[Get]] implementation controls its own return or throw after dispatch.
